games.name: Coin Master
games.description: Spin, build, and raid your way to the top.
games.long_description: Coin Master invites you to spin the slot machine, raid villages, and build your very own Viking empire. Collect coins from daily spins, attack other players' villages to steal their loot, and defend your own by placing powerful traps. Join clans, compete in events, and climb the leaderboards as you upgrade your village to its full glory.

games.name: Royal Match
games.description: Match tiles and restore the royal castle.
games.long_description: Royal Match is a match-3 puzzle adventure where every level you complete helps restore a different room in King Robert's castle. Solve clever puzzles, collect boosters, and decorate rooms with the coins and stars you earn. New challenges and events are added every week to keep the kingdom growing.

games.name: Fishdom
games.description: Solve puzzles and design your dream aquarium.

games.name: Monopoly Go
games.description: Roll the dice and build your empire.
games.long_description: Monopoly Go brings the classic board game to your pocket. Roll the dice, collect rent, build landmarks, and go head-to-head with friends and players around the world in fast, fun mini-events held every day.
